definition: Running AI models directly on devices such as phones, cameras and sensors instead of sending data to the cloud.
details: Edge inference cuts latency and keeps data local, which helps privacy and offline use, but it must fit within tight power, memory and compute budgets. Techniques like quantization and small-model design make this possible.
story: Picture a phone that translates a conversation instantly, even in airplane mode — no cloud, no waiting. That is Edge AI in a sentence: running AI models directly on devices such as phones, cameras and sensors instead of sending data to the cloud. Here is why it matters: edge inference cuts latency and keeps data local, which helps privacy and offline use, but it must fit within tight power, memory and compute budgets. It is the difference between asking a colleague across the room and mailing a letter across the country — some answers have to live where you are. That habit of keeping intelligence close to the data is Edge AI.

citation.title: Convergence of Edge Computing and Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
